regression.note: All 6 URLs match the 2026-09-07 baseline, so every slot has a like-for-like comparison. No URL changed verdict. The accessibility drop (about 5 points on 5 of 6 pages) is driven by the new link-name failure (empty header logo anchor and blank email anchor), which is template-wide. best_practices 100 to 96 on 3 pages is the errors-in-console crawler proxy artifact and is not counted as a site regression.

manual_findings.title: Email renders blank site-wide: footer email link and /contact/ Email card are empty anchors
manual_findings.detail: Rendered HTML contains : the Cloudflare-obfuscated href carries only the 1-byte key with no address, so the site email value passed to the template is an empty string. JSON-LD Organization and LocalBusiness also emit email: "". The client record contact.email is mikior7@gmail.com (a personal Gmail), while onboarding_notes.domain_decision_2026_07_15 says "email stays office@restorationgroups.com". Confirm office@restorationgroups.com with the owner and publish it or suppress the Email row and schema field when the value is empty.
manual_findings.source: manual verification of rendered HTML and JSON-LD; corroborated by Lighthouse link-name

manual_findings.title: Header logo link <a href="/"> is empty: no logo image and no brand text render in the sticky header
manual_findings.detail: body > header.bg-dark > div.container-wide > a.flex contains only whitespace. The brand name is missing from the header on every page, and screen readers announce an unnamed link. Likely a missing logo asset or logo/brand-name config field in the site build.

sameAs still lists both Google cids (8008820373441604497 Kenilworth and 5612453956771500683 Fair Lawn) plus Yelp (Highland Park) and HomeGuide (Paterson) listings in other towns

verified_non_issues.note: Lighthouse sees tel:+19083419611 on every page. This is an inline call-tracking swap script (tp "(908) 341-9611" replaces op "(855) 650-7422" on a[href^="tel:"] at runtime). The static HTML, footer NAP and JSON-LD all carry +18556507422, so crawlers and citations see the GBP line. Intended tracking behaviour, not a NAP defect.

Flagged on /services/, /service-areas/union-nj/ and /contact/ (best_practices 96). Every logged error is net::ERR_SOCKS_CONNECTION_FAILED, a DataForSEO crawler proxy failure, not a site resource error. Home, water and fire pages logged none.
Valid JSON-LD (Organization, LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList, etc.) is present; the DataForSEO check only detects microdata/RDFa.
instant_pages: no broken links or resources, one H1 per page, no duplicate title/description, canonicals self-referencing on all 6 URLs, HSTS present.
Homepage hero-bg.webp already has loading="eager" fetchpriority="high"; lcp-discovery-insight does not fire on / .

environment_caveats: Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (for_mobile=false, formFactor=desktop), matching prior baselines so deltas are like-for-like. Mobile performance would typically score 10-20 points lower; the homepage CLS would likely be worse on mobile.

The on_page_lighthouse / on_page_instant_pages MCP wrappers were not exposed; the audit called POST /v3/on_page/lighthouse/live/json and POST /v3/on_page/instant_pages directly with the same parameters and wrote full responses to disk before parsing (lighthouse_detail extracted, not deferred).
Homepage audited twice: run 1 performance 89, CLS 0.2192; run 2 performance 89, CLS 0.2142, same culprit node. State records run 1.
Apex production origin audited; curl -sI returned no x-robots-tag noindex, so SEO counts toward every verdict.
Service-landing slot: three pages tie at url-plan priority 9.0 (fire, mold, water). Water and fire were kept to preserve the baseline comparison.
